spans.text: In this study, we used Multi-Voxel pattern analyses (MVPA) to examine whether reappraisal and distraction strategies have distinct representations in the older adult brain

value: For older adults, the distraction regions predicted strategy condition significantly above chance (mean accuracy = 0.57, SD = 0.11), but did not significantly differ from the reappraisal regions.

spans.text: There were significant age-by-condition interaction effects within the precuneus, posterior cingulate, and left supramarginal gyrus (reported in Table 2 ).

value: Younger adults showed decreased activation of the precuneus, posterior cingulate, and left supramarginal gyrus during reappraisal than during distraction, whereas older adults showed no differences in activation between strategy conditions.
